title: Compound-specific stable carbon and bromine isotope analysis tracking transformation mechanisms of organobrominated contaminants: a review of principles, methodologies and applications
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2636-2654
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00183H, Critical Review
Haoyu Zeng, Songsong Chen, Xiao Liu, Weiwei Zhang, Ying Liu, Yongzhi Wang, Limin Ma
Organobrominated contaminants pose significant environmental risks due to their persistence, toxicity, and involve complex migration and transformation pathways, which can be differentiated by compound-specific isotope analysis.
